newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley ups cash in U.S. portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley ups cash in U.S. portfolio.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Group Inc confirmed U.S. strategist Byron Wien raised the amount of cash in his model portfolio by three percent.

A Morgan Stanley spokeswoman said the move brings the cash portion of the portfolio to eight percent from five percent but was unable to provide further details on the shift. Wien was unavailable to comment.

But market sources familiar with details of the move said the shift drew down the stocks portion of the portfolio by three percent and was part of a strategy by Wien to sell into stock market rallies.
According to sources, Wien plans additional fund shifts out of stocks and into cash during periods of stock market strength.
